name: hud_ui_message_rebuild_weapon_layout
description: HudUiMessage::RebuildWeaponLayout rebuilds the weapon message base, text panel, and side widget geometry from the layout anchor and image sizes.
known_limits: tier S verification was not attempted in this session; this helper is deferred to a coherent HUD message/source-cluster tier S pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x414070 validates reading g_HudLayoutHW.widget2 GetCenterX/GetCenterY, centering panel.layoutX with g_HudUiMgrHudOriginX / 2, deriving the base widget clip rectangle from variantImages[0] width/height and panel.layoutY, dispatching base SetPos and SetClip, deriving the text-panel clip rectangle with left +3, right -2, and 12 pixel height, centering the text panel X within that rect, dispatching panel SetPos and SetClip, and placing the side widget from sideImageSwaps[0] width/height at the base image lower-right corner.
The native smoke verifies the real typed layout anchor, base SetPos/SetClip coordinates, text panel SetPos/SetClip coordinates, and side widget SetPos coordinates.
